notes.title: We're officially part of the Steam Zombies vs Vampires Fest 2025!
notes.content:
Hey survivors!

[h3][b]We're officially part of the Steam Zombies vs Vampires Fest 2025, and I couldn't be more excited to showcase what I’ve been working on.[/b][/h3]

[b]Over the past few weeks, I've been busy:[/b]
[list]
[*] Crafting a brand-new trailer packed with mutant-blasting action
[*] Creating eye-popping GIFs that show off the chaos
[*] Capturing screenshots that highlight the game’s best moments
[/list]

[b]Boom, Die, Repeat is a roguelite zombie shooter where you:[/b]
[list]
[*] Choose your survivor and build your arsenal
[*] Mutate mid-run with absurd powers
[*] Deploy traps, turrets, and grenades to survive the onslaught
[*] And build totally unhinged loadouts with elemental madness
[/list]


No two runs are the same. Everything from enemy spawns to upgrade paths is randomized - forcing you to adapt on the fly or die trying.

[h3]If you're into action-packed gameplay, apocalyptic vibes, and wild build possibilities, [b][u]don't forget to wishlist and follow the game![/u][/b][/h3]

The Steam Fest runs [i]May 26 to June 2[/i], so be sure to check out the game during the event!

See you in the wasteland.

– Decayed Games
